Which quantum number determines the shape of an atomic orbital?
A) principal (n)  B) azimuthal (l)  C) magnetic (m_l)  D) spin (m_s)

n sets the energy/size, l sets the angular momentum and hence the shape (s, p, d, f), m_l sets the orientation, m_s the spin.

On reflection, the stronger candidate is a) principal (n) — committing to that.

messages.judgeOutput: The response picks the principal quantum number, which determines size and energy, not shape. The reference answer is the azimuthal quantum number l. Verdict: incorrect.
